result.summary: Rework 02f done: the speaker of the question takes its own row only when its title (or stage line) does not fit beside «‹ Назад» in the visitor's font (decisions/0124 О45); there is no pixel threshold any more and the fixed rule max-width 379px of О36 is gone. CSS alone cannot do it: the head of the question is a grid of four siblings, and where the speaker does not fit, «‹ Назад» must move from the row above the question to the row under it (the progress row), while a wrapping flex or grid can only move the item that does not fit to a line after its neighbours in the source order («Назад» would land above the question, not under it), and CSS cannot ask whether a text fits. So a small content measurement in demo.js sets a class and the placements stay in CSS. Nothing else of the look changed: the same three placements as the old own-row rule, the title breaks only at spaces, the progress count goes under the pips where the row is too narrow, the DOM and its focus order are unchanged, no new text, no new file.

It measures the visitor's own font and column, so no window width is involved; a title that breaks at spaces fits, a word wider than the column does not. The language switch and the next question go through put(), so they measure again
